title: orders.status record (Phalanx contract 0.2.0)
description: Order lifecycle: accepted, queued, in work, completed, rejected (with reason). One record per status change.

record_id.description: Idempotency key; blake2b-128 of the topic's record_id_key components (see record_id rules).

dict_version.description: Parameter-dictionary semantic version (M01) the record was produced against.

dict_hash.description: Parameter-dictionary content hash, lower-case hex (M01). Appears on every record.

status_seq.description: Index of this status change within the order (0, 1, 2, ...).

reason.description: Reason; required when status is REJECTED.

t_status.description: Simulation time of the status change. The event and availability time of the record.

result_record_ids.description: record_ids of the normal records the execution produced; empty if none.
